en-US.name: relayium
en-US.subtitle: End-to-end encrypted transfer
en-US.promotionalText: Move files and messages between your own devices, or with someone on the same network. End-to-end encrypted, so Relayium's servers only ever carry ciphertext.
en-US.description:
Relayium moves files and text between devices without handing the contents to a server.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• LAN Transfer — messages and files with another device on the same network. No account, and both devices stay open while it runs.

• Cross-network Transfer — reach a device anywhere with a six-digit code. Showing a code needs a Relayium account; joining a code somebody else is showing does not. Type the six digits, or point the camera at the code on the other device.

• Send a link — hand a large file to someone who picks it up later, with your own expiry and download limits.

• Device Inbox — sign in on two of your own devices and move files and messages between them. Relayium receives while it is open on the receiving device, receiving stays off until you switch it on for that account, and what arrives is saved into Relayium ▸ Received, which you can open in the Files app.

• Account — your plan, your devices and your stored files.

ENCRYPTED END TO END

Files and messages are encrypted on the device that sends them and decrypted on the device that receives them. Relayium's servers carry ciphertext and never hold your keys. Relayium cannot read what you send.

WHAT NEEDS AN ACCOUNT

Device Inbox, stored links, your plan and showing a cross-network code need a Relayium account. LAN Transfer needs none, and neither does joining a cross-network code somebody else is showing.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

Relayium Plus, Pro and Max raise your storage, transfer and retention limits. Every price, period and renewal term is shown in the app before you confirm, and a subscription renews until you cancel it in the App Store.

Terms of Service: https://relayium.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://relayium.com/privacy/
en-US.whatsNew:
Device Inbox now receives on iPhone and iPad. Sign in on two of your own devices, switch receiving on, and move files and messages between them. Relayium receives while it is open on the receiving device, and what arrives is saved into Relayium ▸ Received, where the Files app can reach it.

You can now point the camera at the pairing code another device is showing instead of typing the six digits.

The iPad layout adapts: the same five destinations in a sidebar at full width and in tabs when the window is narrow.

zh-Hans.name: relayium
zh-Hans.subtitle: 端到端加密的设备间传输
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 在你自己的设备之间直接传送文件和消息，也可以和同一网络里的人互传。内容端到端加密，Relayium 的服务器全程只经手密文。
zh-Hans.description:
Relayium 在设备之间传送文件和文字，而不把内容交给服务器。

可以做什么

• 局域网传输 —— 和同一网络里的另一台设备互传消息和文件。不需要账户，两边都保持打开即可。

• 跨网络传输 —— 用六位数字码连上任意位置的设备。出示配对码需要 Relayium 账户；加入别人出示的码则不需要。手动输入那六位数字，或者把摄像头对准对方设备上的码。

• 发送链接 —— 把大文件交给稍后来取的人，有效期和下载次数由你自己定。

• 设备收件箱 —— 在你自己的两台设备上登录同一账户，在它们之间传送文件和消息。Relayium 只在接收端打开时才接收，接收功能在你为该账户开启之前一直关闭，收到的内容保存在 Relayium ▸ 已接收 里，可以在“文件”App 中打开。

• 账户 —— 你的套餐、你的设备和你的已存文件。

端到端加密

文件和消息在发送的那台设备上加密，在接收的那台设备上解密。Relayium 的服务器经手的是密文，也从不持有你的密钥。Relayium 读不到你传送的内容。

哪些功能需要账户

设备收件箱、存储链接、套餐，以及出示跨网络配对码，都需要 Relayium 账户；局域网传输不需要，加入别人出示的跨网络配对码也不需要。

订阅

Relayium Plus、Pro 和 Max 会提高存储、传输和留存上限。价格、周期和续订条款都会在确认购买前于 App 内显示；订阅会持续续订，直到你在 App Store 中取消。

服务条款：https://relayium.com/terms/
隐私政策：https://relayium.com/privacy/
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
设备收件箱现在可以在 iPhone 和 iPad 上接收了。在你自己的两台设备上登录同一账户，开启接收，就能在它们之间传送文件和消息。Relayium 只在接收端打开时才接收，收到的内容保存在 Relayium ▸ 已接收 里，“文件”App 可以直接访问。

现在可以把摄像头对准对方设备显示的配对码，不必再手动输入那六位数字。

iPad 布局会自适应：宽窗口下五个入口在侧边栏，窄窗口下同样是这五个入口，改用标签栏。

appReview.notes:
Relayium is account-gated: the Account, subscription and Device Inbox surfaces need a signed-in Relayium account, so a demo account is supplied in the review fields of this submission. LAN Transfer works signed out. Cross-network Transfer is direction-specific: joining a six-digit code somebody else is showing works signed out, but showing a code requires a signed-in account, because the account that mints the code owns whatever is relayed through it.

Device Inbox needs two devices signed in to the same Relayium account. With one device you can enrol it, switch receiving on and see the empty state, but no delivery can be observed — that is the product working as designed, not a broken screen. A review attachment demonstrating the two-device flow must be supplied with this submission. It has not been produced yet, and this record does not claim it exists; produce it and attach it before submitting, then update this sentence to say it is attached.

Relayium receives only while it is open and in the foreground on the receiving device. Nothing arrives while the app is not in the foreground, and no notification of any kind is delivered at any point. This is shipped behaviour, stated on the Device Inbox screen itself.

Receiving is off by default. It is an explicit per-account opt-in inside the app.

Received files are written into the app's own container and appear in Files ▸ On My iPhone ▸ Relayium ▸ Received (Files ▸ On My iPad ▸ Relayium ▸ Received on iPad).

File and message contents are end-to-end encrypted; they are decrypted only on the receiving device, and Relayium's servers hold ciphertext only.

Cross-network Transfer offers a QR scan on the joining side: it reads only a relayium.com pairing link, and it fills the six-digit field rather than joining. The camera prompt appears after an explicit tap on 'Scan a QR code'. Local Network access is requested at the first transfer to a device on the same network, not at launch.

Subscriptions are sold through StoreKit and validated by Relayium's server before any entitlement is granted. A Sandbox account is not charged.

attachment.purpose: A private review attachment showing one Device Inbox delivery across two devices signed in to one account, which a single-device reviewer cannot reproduce.

betaAppDescription.en-US:
Relayium is an end-to-end encrypted file and message transfer app. This build is the 0.3.0 line: LAN Transfer, Cross-network Transfer with a six-digit code and a QR scan, stored links, Device Inbox between your own devices, and Account.

Read this before filing a bug: Relayium receives only while it is open and in the foreground on the receiving device, and it delivers no notification at any point. A file sent to a device whose Relayium is closed arrives the next time that device opens Relayium. Receiving is off until you switch it on for your account. Device Inbox, stored links, plan screens and showing a cross-network pairing code need a signed-in Relayium account. LAN Transfer works signed out, and so does joining a cross-network code somebody else is showing.
betaAppDescription.zh-Hans:
Relayium 是一个端到端加密的文件与消息传输 App。本构建属于 0.3.0 这一条线：局域网传输、带六位数字码和二维码扫描的跨网络传输、存储链接、你自己设备之间的设备收件箱，以及账户。

提交问题前请先看这一段：Relayium 只在接收端打开并处于前台时才接收，全程不发送任何通知。发给一台 Relayium 已关闭的设备的文件，会在那台设备下次打开 Relayium 时才到达。接收功能在你为账户开启之前一直关闭。设备收件箱、存储链接、套餐界面，以及出示跨网络配对码，都需要登录 Relayium 账户；局域网传输不需要登录，加入别人出示的跨网络配对码也不需要。

whatToTest.en-US:
1. Device Inbox across two devices on one account: switch receiving on, receive a file and a message from the other device, check both directions appear in the per-device conversation, then send a file and a message back. Confirm the received bytes under Files ▸ On My iPhone ▸ Relayium ▸ Received.
2. The foreground boundary: send to a device whose Relayium is closed, confirm nothing arrives and no notification appears, then open Relayium there and confirm it arrives.
3. The five-destination shell: tabs on iPhone, tabs on a compact-width iPad (Slide Over and a narrow Split View), sidebar plus detail column at full width, and a stored link opening over the surface you were on and returning to it.
4. Cross-network Transfer, in both directions: join by typing the six digits, and join by scanning the code the other device shows. Confirm a scan fills the field and does not start a transfer, and that denying the camera leaves manual entry working. Confirm the asymmetry explicitly — signed out, joining a code somebody else is showing works, and showing a code does not; signed in, showing a code works.
5. LAN Transfer on the same network, including the Local Network prompt on a device that has not decided it yet.
6. Account: sign in, all six subscription offers rendering with real prices, one Sandbox purchase, restore, and the Manage Subscription, Privacy Policy and Terms destinations.
7. The Share extension and Universal Links from Safari and Files.
whatToTest.zh-Hans:
1. 两台设备同一账户的设备收件箱：开启接收，从另一台设备接收一个文件和一条消息，确认按设备的会话里两个方向都出现，再回传一个文件和一条消息。在“文件 ▸ 我的 iPhone ▸ Relayium ▸ 已接收”中确认收到的内容。
2. 前台边界：向一台 Relayium 已关闭的设备发送，确认什么都没到达、也没有任何通知，然后在那台设备上打开 Relayium，确认内容随即到达。
3. 五入口外壳：iPhone 上的标签栏、紧凑宽度 iPad 上的标签栏（侧拉与窄分屏）、全宽下的侧边栏加详情栏，以及存储链接覆盖在当前界面之上打开、关闭后回到原界面。
4. 跨网络传输，两个方向都测：手动输入六位数字加入，以及扫描对方设备显示的码加入。确认扫描只填入数字而不会直接开始传输，拒绝相机权限后手动输入仍然可用。并且明确验证这个不对称：未登录时可以加入别人出示的码，但不能出示码；登录后才能出示码。
5. 同一网络下的局域网传输，包括在尚未做出选择的设备上出现的本地网络权限提示。
6. 账户：登录、六个订阅项都以真实价格显示、一次 Sandbox 购买、恢复购买，以及管理订阅、隐私政策和服务条款的跳转。
7. 共享扩展，以及从 Safari 和“文件”打开的 Universal Links。

reviewRequirements: Every proposed product identifier is unique to com.relayium.app. The com.relayium.mac.* identifiers belong to the separate macOS record and must not be reused. Identifiers are permanent once created, so confirm them with the owner before creating anything.
Each product needs its own review information, and Apple may require a review screenshot per product; those are review-only assets and never reach the storefront.
Relayium's apple_products catalogue needs an exact (bundle id, product id) -> (plan, cycle) row for each of the six, read back as live, before a purchase can be accepted.
The production verifier must carry com.relayium.app and Apple ID 6791918822 while retaining the existing macOS identity and both signed environments.
App Store Server Notifications V2 Sandbox and Production URLs must be configured for this record and a signed TEST notification observed reaching Relayium.

blockedBy: The subscription products above do not exist yet, so the Account screen cannot render a real offer list.

capture.note: An earlier version of the prose required capture from the exact signed IPA on the physical fleet. That was wrong, and it is corrected here: what the asset must be honest about is the app's real appearance and real data. An honest Release-configuration simulator capture at one of the exact accepted pixel sizes above is permitted. What is never permitted is a DEBUG build, a --relayium-ui-testing launch, the UITestSubscriptions fixture prices, or a retouched screen. Whether the owner captures on a simulator or on hardware is their choice.

accessibilityNutritionLabel.note: Apple's Accessibility Nutrition Label is a per-device-family claim about tasks a user can actually complete. Nothing here may be claimed until the common tasks have been exercised per device family with the feature switched on. Reconcile this feature list against App Store Connect's own questionnaire at submission time rather than trusting this copy of it.
knownBlockers: Light appearance: enabled body copy drawn in Color.secondary (iOS's own secondaryLabel) measures about 3.3 to 3.4 to 1 against the surfaces behind it, below the 4.5:1 the Sufficient Contrast claim requires for normal text. Measured in pixels off rendered simulator screenshots at 3x; Apple's own audit reports it as 'nearly passed' rather than 'failed', which is an explanation and not a pass. Sufficient Contrast is therefore not claimable on either device family. The previously recorded dark .bordered button blocker is resolved and is no longer the reason: the dark action-label and small-symbol failures were fixed and re-measured between about 4.9 and 7.4 to 1, and apps/ios/RelayiumUITests/AppShellUITests.swift now runs the contrast audit in both appearances and classifies this remaining Light finding explicitly as open rather than as a false positive. Fixing it means replacing the system's secondary label with a token of this app's own across every surface, which is a separate scoped task and is deliberately not part of this metadata batch. Exact per-element ratios are recorded in docs/ios-app-store-submission.md.

features.blocker: Light Color.secondary body text is about 3.3 to 3.4 to 1, below 4.5:1. The dark .bordered label blocker is resolved and re-measured above 4.5:1.
